message.content:
Hi Karan! I’m not able to access real‑time flight data directly, but I can guide you on how to check your Indigo flight status:

1. **Indigo’s Official Website**  
   - Go to [Indigo.com](https://www.indigo.in/).  
   - Click on “Flight Status” in the top menu.  
   - Enter your ticket number **IND4567** and the departure date.  
   - You’ll see the current status (on time, delayed, etc.) and any gate or terminal changes.

2. **Indigo Mobile App**  
   - Open the app and tap “My Bookings.”  
   - Select the booking with ticket number **IND4567**.  
   - The app will display live updates, gate info, and any notifications.

3. **Flight Tracking Websites**  
   - Sites like [FlightAware](https://flightaware.com/) or [FlightRadar24](https://www.flightradar24.com/) let you search by flight number or airline.  
   - Enter “IND” followed by the flight number (e.g., IND4567) to see real‑time tracking.

4. **Customer Support**  
   - Call Indigo’s customer care at **1800-209-9999** (India) or use the chat support on their website if you need immediate assistance.

If you’re traveling soon, it’s a good idea to double‑check a few hours before departure. Safe travels!
